notes: CHK-003/004 run without disable iff (antecedent 1'b1) since they must hold during reset too. CHK-010 only checks W beats once the matching AW is known (an earlier AW handshake or the same edge). If W arrives before AW, those beats are not checked, which is a simplification of the "deferred" wording. I have not compiled this in Verilator.
